visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-orange hair wearing a bright pink hooded sweatshirt speaks directly into the camera in a medium close-up shot. She is positioned in an indoor room with patterned wallpaper. She uses expressive facial movements and hand gestures to communicate, showing her fingernails with rings. (2) The scene transitions to a bright blue sky filled with fluffy white clouds. Large white numbers '2' and '1' appear sequentially in the center of the frame as a countdown. (3) The perspective shifts to an extreme close-up of a human big toe. A manicurist's hands are visible, wearing decorative nail art themselves, using professional metal nail clippers to trim the corners of the thick, yellowed toenail. (4) The manicurist uses a thin metal scraping tool to carefully clean out debris and skin from the side grooves of the toenail. The skin around the nail is slightly red and swollen. A brown towel is visible in the background under the foot. (5) A split-screen comparison appears with text labels 'BEFORE' and 'AFTER', highlighting the difference in the nail's shape and cleanliness. Red dotted circles are used to point out specific problem areas on the nail. (6) Both feet are shown resting on a white surface, with all toenails looking clean, trimmed, and healthy under bright lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and an animated tone. The background music is a mid-tempo, light electronic pop track with a steady drum beat. Speech rate is relatively fast. (2) A clear, bright 'ding' sound effect triggers as the countdown numbers appear, repeated twice. (3) The audio shifts as the female voice becomes more descriptive and instructional. Distinct 'click' sounds from nail clippers are audible, providing sharp percussive transients. (4) Rhythmic metallic scraping and friction sounds are heard, synchronized with the tool moving against the toenail. The narrator's voice maintains high clarity and a friendly demeanor. (5) A high-pitched 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies graphic transitions. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (6) A celebratory cheering and applause sound effect is layered at the end, accompanying the successful result.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Educational Context -> Live Demonstration -> Result Comparison.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the causes and professional treatment of ingrown toenails (referred to as '凍甲' or '嵌甲'). It combines a personal testimonial with a satisfying, detailed demonstration of a professional manicure cleaning process to promote proper foot care.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density text overlays and ASMR-like close-up cleaning sounds to maintain high viewer engagement.
